title: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish inspired by the street food of the Middle East, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, toast the wraps by grilling them for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Assemble the wraps by spreading tahini sauce on the bottom half, followed by a few slices of grilled chicken, some mixed greens, chopped cucumber, chopped tomato, and pickled turnips.
Drizzle with additional tahini sauce, if desired.
